calls.title: Caroline BORGES and James Shannon
calls.summary: The team discussed the evaluation of GrowthBook, highlighting critical factors such as ease of use, flexibility, and AI capabilities. Louis emphasized the need for a visual editor to run tests without coding, alongside the potential advantages of AI-driven features. The flexible integration with BigQuery for metrics was deemed essential for maintaining data control. The unique pricing model based on experiments rather than traffic was recognized as cost-effective, appealing to the team's limited budget. A collaborative decision-making process was established, led by Louis and Caroline, with input from data and engineering teams. Future steps include a detailed product demo tailored to client needs and ongoing evaluation of GrowthBook against competitors.
calls.keywords: GrowthBook, A/B testing, Visual Editor, BigQuery, Feature Flagging, AI Integration
